guarantee.name: Atomic Shelf Commitment
guarantee.headline: Our commitment
guarantee.body: We don't promise that every book will explode overnight. Publishing doesn't work that way — and neither does building a readership. What we do promise is that we'll do the work we've committed to, measure what happens, and stay accountable for the outcome. If we fall short of the work, delivery, or agreed commitments on our side, we'll make it right — at our cost. And when the numbers show that we need to change course, we don't simply point at the dashboard and walk away. We diagnose, adjust, and keep working toward the target.
guarantee.closing_line: Your commitment is to the partnership. Ours is to the work.
does_not_guarantee: A specific number of sales regardless of market conditions
